description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged jump attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Lightning 3 with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode], and [Zenith Mode: Kain (Lightning)] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Kain (Lightning)
